root_idea.summary: A root centered on seeing and perceiving, whether by the eye or by understanding and discernment.
root_idea.development: The lexical branches extend from visual perception to mental apprehension, judgment, reciprocal visibility, outward appearance, ostentatious display, and visions in sleep. These developments are related but are not identical meanings of every derived form.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Core Form I verb with several Quran-attested perception and cognition constructions.
Distinct Form III Quranic verb meaning to act ostentatiously or hypocritically.
Distinct causative Form IV verb meaning to show or cause to see.
Distinct reciprocal Form VI verb meaning to come into one another's sight.
Quranic nominal use in رأي العين, referring to visual perception.
Distinct Quranic nominal meaning outward appearance.
Quranic verbal noun for ostentatious display.
Distinct Quranic noun for a dream or vision in sleep.

senses.definition: To see or perceive with the eye, or through an analogous means of perception.
senses.usage_conditions: Includes ordinary visual perception and expressions in which seeing is attributed analogically to one whose perception is not bodily.

senses.definition: To suppose, imagine, or envisage something as being the case.
senses.usage_conditions: A mental or imaginative apprehension rather than direct physical sight; tense and mood may make the sense hypothetical or prospective.

senses.definition: To discern through reflection or deliberate consideration.
senses.usage_conditions: Used when the act of seeing denotes attentive reflection that brings something to perception or understanding.

senses.definition: To mentally perceive, know, or judge something to be so.
senses.usage_conditions: With two objects, the construction presents a person or thing as possessing a stated quality; this branch also covers the Quranic use meaning that something has been made known or taught.

senses.definition: To consider a matter attentively so as to take warning or draw an admonition.
senses.usage_conditions: Especially occurs with إِلَى in the construction أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى, which directs attention toward a case and its significance rather than merely asking about visual sight.

senses.definition: In أَرَأَيْتَ and related expressions, to call for an account of a matter: “tell me” or “have you considered?”
senses.usage_conditions: A conventional attention-arousing construction; the attached ك may function as an allocutive particle, while the verb retains its person and number marking.

senses.definition: To act ostentatiously or hypocritically, doing something so that people will see it and think well of the doer.
senses.usage_conditions: The action is directed toward being seen by people rather than performed sincerely for God; the Quranic forms are imperfective.

senses.definition: To cause someone to see; to show or present something to someone.
senses.usage_conditions: A causative construction that may take a person as recipient and a thing or event as what is shown; active, passive, imperative, and imperfective forms occur in the Quran.

senses.definition: To come into one another's sight; to see one another while approaching and facing each other.
senses.usage_conditions: A reciprocal construction in which each party becomes positioned so that the other can see it; it may also describe two groups coming into view of one another.

senses.definition: The sight or visual observation of the eye; what is perceived by direct seeing.
senses.usage_conditions: In رأي العين, it marks an assessment made according to visible observation rather than abstract estimation.
Refers to the condition or appearance presented to the eye, including an appearance of goodly condition or apparel.

senses.definition: Ostentatious display: doing something so that people will see it and think well of the doer.
senses.usage_conditions: Denotes displaying an act to people, especially when it is not performed sincerely for God.

senses.definition: A dream or vision experienced in sleep.
senses.usage_conditions: The noun may refer to one dream, a prophetic or significant vision, or visions in the plural.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To see or fancy that one sees a vision in sleep; to dream.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional sleep-related use of the Form I verb, distinct from the Quranic noun رُؤْيَا.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An opinion, belief, judgment, or considered view; also the intelligence, foresight, and practical skill behind such a view.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes forming or holding an opinion about an affair, law, or doctrine, and by extension counsel or advice.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Above all, especially.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed idiomatic expression in which omitted elements are understood; it is not an ordinary request to see.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a woman, to notice the slight yellowness, whiteness, or blood associated with menstruation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized expression concerning signs observed around the time of menstruation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To strike or hurt a person's lungs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate homonymous lexical branch with رِئَة as its object; the passive may describe a complaint of the lungs.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To stick or fix a banner or standard into the ground; رَأْيَة is a banner or standard.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The nominal is commonly pronounced رَايَة after omission of the hamza.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a fire-stick, to become kindled; transitively, to kindle it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use referring to the ignition of a piece of wood used for producing fire.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hold, present, or reserve a mirror for someone so that he may look at or see himself in it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is the mirror and the beneficiary is the person enabled to look.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To face someone or something so as to see it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A spatial construction distinct from the Quranic ethical sense of acting for display.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To think or judge someone to possess a stated quality.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in a poetic construction where the person is judged to be chaste; the accompanying context supplies the particular example, not a general restriction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To consult someone or ask his counsel or advice.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May be followed by فِي concerning the matter on which advice is sought.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To show people punishment, destruction, or a fate that causes an enemy to rejoice, through the example of someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This specialized expression is said only in relation to an evil outcome.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give or hand something to someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized imperative use in which the requested object is handed over, rather than displayed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make someone know or understand that another person or thing possesses a stated quality.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In this extended causative construction the verb may take three objective complements.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To look at oneself in a mirror, in a sword, or in water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive use referring to looking at one's face or reflection.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To have many dreams.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form IV lexical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To move the eyelids or make much motion with the eyes while looking.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of conspicuous or repeated eye movement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To act well or righteously in order that others may see and hear of the act.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This Classical specialization concerns performing for public notice; it is distinct from the Quranic Form III headword.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To possess or acquire intelligence, judgment, and foresight.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized lexical use describing practical discernment or competence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bear on the face an indication of foolishness or stupidity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The source records this as a specialized and potentially contrasting use requiring lexical caution.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To have a رَئِيّ, a jinni companion or follower associated with the person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized supernatural usage involving a jinni who presents himself or accompanies someone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To follow the opinion or legal view of another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use concerning adherence to another person's legal judgment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a female animal or woman, to show by the udder or bodily signs that she is pregnant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a pregnant female whose condition has become evident; the source includes several animal and human applications.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a camel, to have the muzzle naturally bent back or thin in the throatward direction.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare anatomical description of a camel's muzzle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To present oneself to another's sight, or for another to see one.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nonreciprocal presentation construction with لِ or لَهُ; it is distinct from the Quranic reciprocal construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of palm-trees, to show the colors of their unripe dates.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized intransitive use concerning the visible appearance of palms.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To test or jointly attempt to see the new moon.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes people directing their sight toward the moon in order to determine whether it can be seen.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To adopt, incline toward, and conform to another person's opinion or belief.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reflexive construction concerning adherence to a view.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To inspect, reflect on, consider, and deliberately decide about an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May also mean to see with the eye or mind, but the specialized branch emphasizes deliberate examination and considered action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To call for, demand, or require the seeing of a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form X request or demand for something to be shown or seen.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be counted, esteemed, or regarded as hypocritical or ostentatious.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive evaluative use derived from the branch of ostentatious display.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In a reported expression, darkness so confused that people could not see one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare expression preserved as a lexicalized description of loss of mutual visibility.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An indication or visible sign of a thing, including an indication of foolishness or ugliness in the face.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sign may reveal an otherwise hidden condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Sight or perception, by the eye and, in some usage, by the mind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A verbal noun and substantive for the act or faculty of seeing; this entry also records the visual appearance of the moon at its first visibility.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The visible first appearance, or phasis, of the moon.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized astronomical or calendrical use of the noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In spatial expressions, facing or standing opposite one another; within sight or as far as the eye reaches; by extension, as many as can be seen.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a Classical spatial branch of the form and is distinct from Quranic رِئَاء meaning ostentatious display.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A jinni that presents itself to a person, teaches or practices divination, or acts as a follower or companion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sources report several closely related descriptions of the supernatural companion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A great serpent said to present itself to a person's sight.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized traditional identification, sometimes explained through the notion of a transformed jinni.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A garment or piece of cloth spread out for sale.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate nominal use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who sees much.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive nominal description based on repeated or abundant seeing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Seeing; one who sees.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The active participle of the basic seeing verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Still or motionless.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate homonymous lexical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: More or most apt, suitable, competent, proper, or worthy for a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in comparative or superlative expressions of fitness or suitability.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Beauty or goodliness, especially beauty of aspect.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantive use distinct from the verbal noun of Form II.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A slight yellowness, whiteness, or blood observed around menstruation; in some usage, the cloth used to detect it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized gynecological term derived from observing the sign of menstruation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who practices evasions, shifts, wiles, or artifices.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal description of someone skilled in evasive devices.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Within one's sight and hearing; in a position where someone can be seen and heard.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed adverbial expression describing accessibility to both sight and hearing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a camel's head, long in the muzzle and bent downward in a characteristic form.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare anatomical description of a camel's head.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a female animal or woman, showing by the udder that she is pregnant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A participial adjective for the condition described under أَرْأَتْ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Apt, suitable, competent, or worthy for a thing or action.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with a preposition or an infinitival construction to express fitness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mirror.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete noun for an object in which the forms of things are seen.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A hypocrite or ostentatious person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An active participial noun derived from the branch of ostentatious display.

cautions: Lane's printed Quran citations use historical conventions and are not treated as modern verse locations unless the corresponding QAC location independently identifies the passage.

Several homographic branches concern the lungs, banners, mirrors, appearance, pregnancy signs, and ostentation; they are kept separate from the Quranic Form I seeing branch unless the lexical evidence explicitly connects the use.

The Quranic form group for رأَى is authoritative for identifying inflected forms such as أَرَاكَ; related causative interpretations are therefore assigned to the QAC form group in which the occurrence is classified.
